meaning: Let x be in potency in no respect. If its life began or ended, or had succession, it would be changed and hence in potency in some respect (STMT-CHANGE-REQUIRES-POTENCY), contradicting pure act; so its life is interminable and all at once. By STMT-PURE-ACT-LIVES it lives at some time. These are the three conjuncts of Boethian eternity (DEF-BOETHIAN-ETERNAL), which instantiates the Eternal parameter.
